name: What are the benefits of repairing a broken window balance versus replacing the entire window?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of repairing a broken window balance versus replacing the entire window?

acceptedAnswer.text: Repairing a broken window balance is significantly more cost-effective than replacing an entire window, especially if the window frame and glass are still in good condition. It's a targeted repair that restores full functionality, improves energy efficiency by ensuring a proper seal, and extends the lifespan of your existing windows. This option is also less disruptive, quicker to complete, and often more environmentally friendly as it reduces waste compared to full window replacement.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repairing a balance is more cost-effective, less disruptive, and quicker than full window replacement. It restores function, improves efficiency, and extends window lifespan.
